verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack and a clear headline > subline > CTA order, which suits the square. Its flaws: the subline wraps and leaves 'flavours.' alone on the second line, and the button lost its pill shape, becoming an oversized rounded rectangle. B keeps the pill and gives the headline more presence, but it breaks the centred axis. Its centre-aligned three-line subline sits in an arbitrary left column next to an off-axis button, and neither lines up with the headline's edges. That bottom row feels cramped beside the roomy headline area and doesn't read like the same design.
